grade.message: Ryanair cancelled our flight to Catania FRR63A on 15 October because of the Etna eruption. The hotel (AMF-R63B, 390 euros, non refundable) marked us no-show and refused to waive it, and my card dispute came back rejected. This is outrageous. The eruption was nobody's fault, so do not log it as Ryanair's, and do not send the hotel to a goodwill desk, I want a plain yes or no on it. I want the flight money, the 400 euro compensation and the hotel refunded. kasia.nowak@example.com, 7710.
